available.quote: The Department may, in its discretion, license as a home inspector, by endorsement, on payment of the required fee, an applicant who is a home inspector licensed under the laws of another state or territory, if (i) the requirements for licensure in the state or territory in which the applicant was licensed were, at the date of licensure, substantially equivalent to the requirements in force in this State on that date

requirements.value: Licensure by endorsement available at Department's discretion if the other state's requirements were substantially equivalent to Illinois requirements at the date of licensure, or if the applicant possessed individual qualifications substantially similar to Illinois requirements.
requirements.quote: the requirements for licensure in the state or territory in which the applicant was licensed were, at the date of licensure, substantially equivalent to the requirements in force in this State on that date or (ii) there were no requirements in force in this State on the date of licensure and the applicant possessed individual qualifications on that date that are substantially similar to the requirements under this Act.

exists.quote: "Department" means the Department of Financial and Professional Regulation.

regulatory_model.quote: It is unlawful for any person, including any entity, to act or assume to act as a home inspector, to engage in the business of home inspection, to develop a home inspection report, to practice as a home inspector, or to advertise or hold oneself out to be a home inspector without a home inspector license issued under this Act.

credential_type.quote: "License" means the privilege conferred by the Department to a person who has fulfilled all requirements prerequisite to any type of licensure under this Act.

is_mandatory.quote: It is unlawful for any person, including any entity, to act or assume to act as a home inspector, to engage in the business of home inspection, to develop a home inspection report, to practice as a home inspector, or to advertise or hold oneself out to be a home inspector without a home inspector license issued under this Act.

title_protection.quote: It is unlawful for any person, other than a person who holds a valid home inspector license issued pursuant to this Act, to use the title "home inspector" or any other title, designation, or abbreviation likely to create the impression that the person is licensed as a home inspector pursuant to this Act.

scope_protection.quote: It is unlawful for any person, including any entity, to act or assume to act as a home inspector, to engage in the business of home inspection, to develop a home inspection report, to practice as a home inspector, or to advertise or hold oneself out to be a home inspector without a home inspector license issued under this Act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud or misrepresentation in applying for or procuring a license, including renewal applications.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fraud or misrepresentation in applying for, or procuring a license under this Act or in connection with applying for renewal of a license under this Act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to meet the minimum qualifications for licensure as a home inspector.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to meet the minimum qualifications for licensure as a home inspector established by this Act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Paying money or anything of value to a Department employee to procure licensure.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Paying money, other than for the fees provided for by this Act, or anything of value to an employee of the Department to procure licensure under this Act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of or plea to a felony, misdemeanor, administrative sanction, or sex offense requiring registration.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of, or plea of guilty or nolo contendere, or finding as enumerated in subsection (c) of Section 5-10, under the laws of any jurisdiction of the United States: (i) that is a felony, misdemeanor, or administrative sanction, or (ii) that is a crime that subjects the licensee to compliance with the requirements of the Sex Offender Registration Act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing an act involving dishonesty, fraud, or misrepresentation intended to substantially benefit or injure a person.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committing an act or omission involving dishonesty, fraud, or misrepresentation with the intent to substantially benefit the licensee or another person or with the intent to substantially injure another person.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating a provision or standard for the development or communication of home inspections.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating a provision or standard for the development or communication of home inspections as provided in Section 10-5 of this Act or as defined in the rules.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing or refusing to exercise reasonable diligence in developing, reporting, or communicating a home inspection report.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing or refusing to exercise reasonable diligence in the development, reporting, or communication of a home inspection report, as defined by this Act or the rules.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating any provision of this Act or the rules promulgated under it.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating a provision of this Act or the rules.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having been disciplined by another state or governmental authority for substantially equivalent grounds.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having been disciplined by another state, the District of Columbia, a territory, a foreign nation, a governmental agency, or any other entity authorized to impose discipline if at least one of the grounds for that discipline is the same as or substantially equivalent to one of the grounds for which a licensee may be disciplined under this Act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in dishonorable, unethical, or unprofessional conduct likely to deceive, defraud, or harm the public.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in dishonorable, unethical, or unprofessional conduct of a character likely to deceive, defraud, or harm the public.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Accepting an inspection assignment where employment or fee is contingent on a predetermined analysis or conclusion.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Accepting an inspection assignment when the employment itself is contingent upon the home inspector reporting a predetermined analysis or opinion, or when the fee to be paid is contingent upon the analysis, opinion, or conclusion reached or upon the consequences resulting from the home inspection assignment.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Developing inspection opinions or conclusions based on a protected class of prospective owners or occupants.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Developing home inspection opinions or conclusions based on the race, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, age, marital status, family status, physical or mental disability, military status, unfavorable discharge from military status, sexual orientation, order of protection status, pregnancy, or any other protected class as defined under the Illinois Human Rights Act

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being adjudicated liable in a civil proceeding on grounds of fraud, misrepresentation, or deceit.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being adjudicated liable in a civil proceeding on grounds of fraud, misrepresentation, or deceit.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being adjudicated liable in a civil proceeding for violation of a State or federal fair housing law.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being adjudicated liable in a civil proceeding for violation of a State or federal fair housing law.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in misleading or untruthful advertising or using a trade name of a home inspection organization the licensee is not a member of.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in misleading or untruthful advertising or using a trade name or insignia of membership in a home inspection organization of which the licensee is not a member.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing within 30 days to provide information in response to a written request by the Department.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing, within 30 days, to provide information in response to a written request made by the Department.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to include the home inspector's license number and expiration date, and names of all persons who conducted the inspection, in the home inspection report.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to include within the home inspection report the home inspector's license number and the date of expiration of the license.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advising a client as to whether the client should or should not engage in a real estate transaction.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Advising a client as to whether the client should or should not engage in a transaction regarding the residential real property that is the subject of the home inspection.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing a home inspection in a manner that damages or alters the residential real property without owner consent.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Performing a home inspection in a manner that damages or alters the residential real property that is the subject of the home inspection without the consent of the owner.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing a home inspection while also providing other services or having an interest in the property without prior written disclosure and client consent.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Performing a home inspection when the home inspector is providing or may also provide other services in connection with the residential real property or transaction, or has an interest in the residential real property, without providing prior written notice of the potential or actual conflict and obtaining the prior consent of the client as provided by rule.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Aiding or assisting another person in violating any provision of this Act or its rules.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Aiding or assisting another person in violating any provision of this Act or rules adopted under this Act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Inability to practice with reasonable judgment, skill, or safety due to habitual or excessive use of or addiction to alcohol, narcotics, or other chemical agents.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Inability to practice with reasonable judgment, skill, or safety as a result of habitual or excessive use or addiction to alcohol, narcotics, stimulants, or any other chemical agent or drug.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating the terms of a probationary license status.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A finding by the Department that the licensee, after having the license placed on probationary status, has violated the terms of probation.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully making or filing false records or reports related to home inspection practice.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willfully making or filing false records or reports related to the practice of home inspection, including, but not limited to, false records filed with State agencies or departments.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Charging for professional services not rendered, including filing false statements for fee collection.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Charging for professional services not rendered, including filing false statements for the collection of fees for which services are not rendered.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing under a false or assumed name.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing under a false or, except as provided by law, an assumed name.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Cheating on or attempting to subvert the licensing examination.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Cheating on or attempting to subvert the licensing examination administered under this Act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in prohibited fraudulent, false, deceptive, or misleading advertising practices including advertising without a licensed inspector responsible for activities.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in any of the following prohibited fraudulent, false, deceptive, or misleading advertising practices: (i) advertising as a home inspector or operating a home inspection business entity unless there is a duly licensed home inspector responsible for all inspection activities and all inspections

disciplinary_grounds.description: Disclosing inspection results or client information without the client's written consent, or delivering a report to a non-client without client consent.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Disclosing, except as otherwise required by law, inspection results or client information obtained without the client's written consent. A home inspector shall not deliver a home inspection report to any person other than the client of the home inspector without the client's written consent.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Providing fees, gifts, waivers, or other compensation to real estate licensees as inducement for referral of business.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Providing fees, gifts, waivers of liability, or other forms of compensation or gratuities to persons licensed under any real estate professional licensing act in this State as consideration or inducement for the referral of business.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating the terms of any order issued by the Department.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating the terms of any order issued by the Department.

insurance_required.quote: All applicants for a home inspector license and all licensees shall maintain general liability insurance in an amount of not less than $100,000.

establishment_regulation_required.quote: Every entity that is not a natural person that desires to obtain a home inspector license shall apply to the Department in a manner prescribed by the Department and accompanied by the required fee.

definition_quote.value: "Home inspection" means the examination and evaluation of the exterior and interior components of residential real property, which includes the inspection of any 2 or more of the following components of residential real property in connection with or to facilitate the sale, lease, or other conveyance of, or the proposed sale, lease or other conveyance of, residential real property: (1) heating, ventilation, and air conditioning system; (2) plumbing system; (3) electrical system; (4) structural composition; (5) foundation; (6) roof; (7) masonry structure; or (8) any other residential real property component as established by rule.

standards_of_practice_body.quote: All persons licensed under this Act must comply with standards of professional home inspection adopted by the Department and established by rule. The Department may consider nationally recognized standards and codes prior to adopting the rules for the standards of practice.

entity_license_required.quote: Every entity that is not a natural person that desires to obtain a home inspector license shall apply to the Department in a manner prescribed by the Department and accompanied by the required fee.

inspection_report_record_retention_years.quote: A person licensed under this Act shall retain the original or a true and exact copy of all written contracts that engage the licensee's services as a home inspector and all home inspection reports, including any supporting data used to develop the home inspection report, for a period of 5 years or 2 years after the final disposition of any judicial proceeding, which includes any appeal, in which testimony was given, whichever is longer.
